engines: Diesel: 2.5 (YD25DDTi, common-rail turbo). Petrol: 2.5 (QR25DE). Later models in some markets: 2.4 diesel (4N16).
market: General export (VINs starting JN1). Specs differ by market and engine.
summary: Starter page compiled from public sources in November 2026. Every fact links to where it came from and starts as Not checked: confirm each one on the bus (door-pillar label, engine plate) or in its owner's manual before relying on it. Nissan's published service schedule for South Africa was only partly readable, so the intervals here need checking against the bus's own service booklet.

facts.label: Diesel engine
facts.value: YD25DDTi 2.5 L common-rail turbo diesel: 95 kW (129 hp) at 3200 rpm, 356 N·m at 1400–2000 rpm
facts.source_name: Nissan Sri Lanka NV350 Urvan brochure

facts.label: Gearbox
facts.value: 5-speed manual
facts.detail: Some markets also list a 5-speed automatic; the newer 4N16 models use a 7-speed automatic (Nissan Singapore).
facts.source_name: Nissan Sri Lanka NV350 Urvan brochure

facts.label: Newer diesel in some markets
facts.value: 4N16 2.4 L: 132 PS at 3250 rpm, 370 N·m at 2000 rpm, 7-speed automatic

facts.label: Fuel tank
facts.value: 65 litres

facts.label: Brakes and safety
facts.value: ABS, Brake Assist (selected models), front airbags
facts.source_name: Nissan Sri Lanka NV350 Urvan brochure

facts.label: Engine oil amount
facts.value: 7.8 L with filter, 7.5 L without
facts.detail: The Thai Urvan owner's manual asks for genuine Nissan engine oil. The Cabstar truck with the same engine is listed at 7.2 L elsewhere, so fill to the dipstick.

facts.label: Engine oil grade
facts.value: Never use API CG-4 grade oil
facts.detail: From Nissan South Africa's NV350 schedule. Nissan's Serena manual for the same engine lists CF-4 10W-30 from the factory. Confirm the grade for your climate in the owner's manual.
facts.source_name: Nissan South Africa NV350 maintenance schedule

facts.label: Engine oil and filter (severe use)
facts.value: Every 7,500 km or 6 months
facts.detail: Nissan's interval for severe use (dusty roads, short trips, heavy loads, heat). Daily staff runs in Grenada's heat probably count. The normal-use interval couldn't be read from the PDF; Autodoc lists 15,000 km or 12 months.
facts.source_name: Nissan South Africa NV350 maintenance schedule

facts.label: Brake fluid (severe use)
facts.value: Every 15,000 km or 12 months
facts.detail: The PDF's text was jumbled here: confirm in the service booklet.
facts.source_name: Nissan South Africa NV350 maintenance schedule

facts.label: Coolant
facts.value: Check the mixture every 30,000 km or 24 months; replace first at 150,000 km or 96 months, then every 75,000 km or 48 months
facts.applies_to: Petrol QR25DE (the diesel's row couldn't be read)
facts.source_name: Nissan South Africa NV350 maintenance schedule

facts.label: Fuel filter and air filter
facts.value: On the schedule, more often under severe use
facts.detail: The schedule marks both for more frequent replacement in severe conditions, but the intervals couldn't be read. Ask a Nissan dealer or check the bus's service booklet.
facts.source_name: Nissan South Africa NV350 maintenance schedule

facts.label: Wheel nut torque
facts.value: 108 N·m (11 kg-m, 80 ft-lb)
facts.detail: Recheck after the first 1,000 km and after a tyre rotation (Thai Urvan manual), and at each service (South African manual).

facts.label: Tyre size
facts.detail: Nissan Kenya's brochure gives the same; tyre databases list LT195R15 8PR on 5.5J×15 wheels.

facts.label: Tyre pressures
facts.value: Use the tyre placard on the bus: front and rear differ, laden and unladen
facts.detail: Set each axle's pressure before loading or unloading.

facts.label: Nissan oil filter
facts.applies_to: Listed for NV350 Urvan, Navara, NP300, Cabstar
facts.detail: A parts-store listing, not Nissan's own catalogue: confirm by chassis number before ordering.

facts.label: Nissan air filter
facts.detail: A parts-store listing, not Nissan's own catalogue: confirm by chassis number before ordering.

facts.label: Timing chain wear
facts.value: A rattle on start-up and rough running are the early signs
facts.applies_to: YD25DDTi (reported mainly on the Navara D22 and D40)
facts.detail: Blamed on a single-row primary chain; double-row aftermarket kits exist. Not confirmed for the NV350 itself, but it is the same engine.

facts.label: Injector trouble
facts.value: Hard starting, rough idle, heavy smoke
facts.detail: Usually blamed on poor fuel and neglected fuel filters.

facts.label: Turbo failures reported
facts.value: One owner's turbo failed at about 210,000 miles, and they found about four other Urvan E26s in Mauritius with the same problem

facts.label: Recalls
facts.value: Ask a Nissan dealer to check each chassis number for open campaigns
facts.detail: This research did not cover NV350 recall lists.

facts.label: Still to find
facts.value: Coolant amount, gearbox oil, tyre pressures, fuel filter part number
facts.detail: The Thai owner's manual lists several unlabeled YD25 figures from 11.0 to 12.6 L, probably coolant amounts for different versions: read the right row in the manual. Then add the facts here and mark them checked.
